### 
Assam NRC Cases
![expand](https://uidai.gov.in/assets/svgs/AccordionArrow.svg)
You can check the status of Aadhaar generation from https://myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in/CheckAadhaarStatus by entering enrolment number (Enrolment ID), date and time given on the acknowledgement slip. If status is displayed as “Your Aadhaar has been generated”: You can view and download the electronic copy of Aadhaar i.e. e-Aadhaar from https://myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in/genricDownloadAadhaar This requires mobile OTP auth
